label: Medium daily digest
schedule: Every morning · its own container · local Qwen 27B through LiteLLM

steps.title: supercronic starts medium-digest
steps.note: A plain Node script with no agent framework. It starts medium-reader-mcp as a child process and talks to it over MCP.

steps.title: digest_begin
steps.note: The job's code makes this call. The server collects Following, top picks and For you, drops what was already reported, has Jev rank every headline, and writes a run file. It hands back the posts as refs.

steps.title: Which headlines to read
steps.note: One question with a JSON schema: the ranked rows, the reader's interests and recent reading in, refs out. Code checks the caps and drops any ref the model invents.

steps.title: read_post by ref
steps.note: The job fetches each shortlisted post by ref. The server resolves F1 from the run file, so nobody copies a URL and nothing can be renumbered.

steps.title: One verdict per post
steps.note: The post's full text in, a verdict out. The gist has to state the argument, not the topic, and depth says how much you lose by reading only the gist.
steps.output:

  "depth": 5,

}

steps.title: Which posts get a ⭐
steps.note: One last question over all the verdicts. None is a valid answer when nothing is strong.

steps.title: digest_finish
steps.note: Code assembles the arguments from the answers. The server validates every ref, fills in titles and links, saves state, and lays out the message.

label: Spotify discovery lane
schedule: Every morning · six genre lanes in a row · local Qwen 27B through LiteLLM, $0

steps.title: supercronic starts the lanes
steps.note: One command runs all six lanes in order. Each adds 3–6 tracks to the day's private playlist. An expired login or a Spotify block stops the rest.

steps.title: discovery_begin
steps.note: Finds or creates today's playlist, pulls new releases from the lane's known labels and artists within a request budget, and hands out K refs.
